create_siren_network: create a SIREN neural network with sine activations and specified layer dimensions for continuous function regression
build_basis_smearing: build a Basis module with powersine or gauss smearing to encode input features into higher-dimensional representations
create_fourier_smearing: create a FourierSmearing module to apply sinusoidal frequency encoding to input features for neural network inputs
build_spherical_smearing: build a SphericalSmearing module to compute real-valued spherical harmonics from normalized 3D direction vectors
create_gaussian_smearing: create a GaussianSmearing module to apply Gaussian basis function expansion to input features with configurable frequency range
